article.title: Trump TV launched after major U.S. networks suspend presidential coverage
article.author: Editor
article.content: The White House began broadcasting on its new media platform, Trump TV, this week, streaming government content, announcements and archived speeches on a continuous basis, days after the country’s major television networks suspended coverage of presidential events. The post Trump TV launched after major U.S. networks suspend presidential coverage appeared first on MR Online .
